visual_brief.subject: An unattended coding-agent run produces many candidate parts while human review keeps only the two robust changes
verified_context: Google's second ADK run used repository skills, a persistent goal, four benchmark workloads, and all 16,892 unit tests over 11 hours.
The run proposed six optimizations, but maintainers rejected four after review and merged two changes across 22 files.
The accepted changes improved scoped session-copy and import workloads while preserving the public API and model requests.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: The agent explores broadly; the maintainer subtracts until only measured, compatible work remains.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A long paper-and-stone workbench passes six varied crafted components through a large brass review press; four rest in a quiet side tray while two precise finished pieces continue on a clear path, rendered as an editorial workshop rather than a flowchart.
